title: Backup executor targeting placement
observed_behavior: BackupDefinition carries executor_labels and capability_requirements fields.
Worker records carry scheduling_state, labels, and generic capabilities.
Backup backend capability declarations are available through BackupBackendResolver.
intended_behavior: Bahia validates whether a backup definition can be placed on registered workers without polling or timeout-based completion.
Bahia selects executor worker pubkeys according to a deterministic executor selection policy.
Bahia returns structured placement reasons for backend incompatibility and per-worker rejection causes.
scope: internal/domain placement decision and reason types
unit tests for placement validation and executor selection
out_of_scope: database schema changes beyond existing BackupDefinition targeting fields
